subjects.name: General Studies & Bihar Special GK (सामान्य अध्ययन एवं बिहार सामान्य ज्ञान)
domains: Ancient Bihar & Indian History: Magadha Empire, Maurya Dynasty (Chandragupta, Ashoka), Nalanda & Vikramshila Universities
Buddhism and Jainism in Bihar: Mahavira (Vaishali, Pavapuri), Gautama Buddha (Bodh Gaya enlightenment)
Medieval Bihar: Sher Shah Suri (Sasaram Tomb, Grand Trunk Road), Battle of Buxar 1764
Modern Freedom Movement in Bihar: Champaran Satyagraha 1917, Veer Kunwar Singh (1857 Revolt in Jagdishpur), Jayaprakash Narayan (Sampoorna Kranti)
Bihar Geography: 38 Districts, 9 Divisions, Ganga River system, Kosi (Sorrow of Bihar), Gandak, Son, Falgu rivers
Bihar Agriculture, Economy & Minerals: Rice, Maize, Makhana, Litchi (Shahi Litchi of Muzaffarpur), Pyrite in Rohtas
Bihar Wildlife & Sanctuaries: Valmiki National Park (West Champaran), Kanwar Lake Bird Sanctuary (Begusarai), Vikramshila Gangetic Dolphin Sanctuary (Bhagalpur)
Indian Constitution & Polity: Fundamental Rights, Preamble, Parliament, Bihar Vidhan Sabha (243 seats), Bihar Vidhan Parishad (75 seats), Lok Sabha (40 seats)
National & International Current Affairs, Awards & Sports

subjects.name: General Science (सामान्य विज्ञान - भौतिकी, रसायन, जीव विज्ञान)
domains: Physics: SI Units, Motion, Newton's Laws, Work, Energy & Power, Gravitation, Sound Waves, Light Reflection & Refraction, Electricity & Ohm's Law
Chemistry: Matter & States, Atomic Structure, Periodic Table Classification, Acids, Bases & Salts (pH scale), Metals & Non-metals, Carbon Compounds
Biology: Cell Structure & Functions (Organelles), Plant & Animal Tissues, Human Organ Systems (Digestive, Circulatory, Respiratory, Nervous, Excretory)
Nutrition & Health: Vitamins & Deficiency Diseases, Infectious Diseases (Bacterial, Viral), Vaccination & Immunology
Ecology & Environment: Ecosystems, Food Chains, Biodiversity Conservation, Environmental Pollution & Global Warming

subjects.name: Hindi Language & Literature (हिन्दी भाषा एवं साहित्य)
domains: हिन्दी वर्णमाला, स्वर, व्यंजन, उच्चारण स्थान (कण्ठ्य, तालव्य, मूर्धन्य, दन्त्य, ओष्ठ्य)
सन्धि (दीर्घ, गुण, वृद्धि, यण, अयादि, व्यंजन, विसर्ग)
समास (अव्ययीभाव, तत्पुरुष, कर्मधारय, द्विगु, द्वन्द्व, बहुव्रीहि)
तद्भव एवं तत्सम शब्द
पर्यायवाची शब्द एवं विलोम शब्द
अनेक शब्दों के लिए एक शब्द
मुहावरे एवं लोकोक्तियां
वाक्य शुद्धि, लिंग, वचन, कारक एवं काल
प्रमुख कवि, लेखक एवं रचनाएं (रामधारी सिंह 'दिनकर', फणीश्वर नाथ रेणु, विद्यापति, नागार्जुन)

subjects.name: English & Mathematics (अंग्रेजी भाषा एवं संख्यात्मक योग्यता)
domains: English Grammar: Parts of Speech (Nouns, Pronouns, Verbs, Adjectives, Prepositions, Conjunctions)
Tenses & Subject-Verb Agreement
Vocabulary: Synonyms, Antonyms, Idioms & Phrases, Spelling Corrections
Sentence Improvement & Error Spotting
Mathematics: Number System, Divisibility Rules, LCM & HCF
Simplification & BODMAS, Decimals & Fractions
Percentages, Profit & Loss, Simple Interest & Compound Interest
Ratio & Proportion, Average & Age Problems
Time & Work, Speed, Distance & Trains
Mensuration 2D & 3D (Area of triangle, rectangle, circle; Volume of cylinder, sphere)
